<ic> To confirm that the title of Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial is a sinecure appointed by the Highguard National Assembly on an Annual basis.<br><br>
<i>Proposed by Bastion, Seconded by Kahraman.</i></ic>

===Overview===
* This motion was to clarify the appointment method of the [[Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial]]
* Passed

===Date===
* Summer 381YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The appointment and removal methods for the title have been amended.
